name: Shagbark Hickory
desc: Shagbark Hickory (Carya ovata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 13 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carya ovata, the shagbark hickory, is a common hickory native to eastern North America, with two varieties. The trees can grow to quite a large size but are unreliable in their fruit output.
